expectedUsable: Every booking field has a persistent, programmatically associated label that stays visible and announced after the user starts typing.

violations.expectedFix: Add a real <label> (associated via for/id) for each input; keep the placeholder only as an example/format hint, not as the label.
violations.notes: A strong two-engine demonstration: axe treats the placeholder as an accessible name and reports NO violation, but pa11y/HTMLCS correctly flags each field as an error (F68 / Input.Name, missing label). Single-vendor scanning would miss this; Layer A catches it because it runs both engines. (The deeper 'placeholder vanishes on input' nuance is also observable by Layer B.)
